title: Footage of the Iranian vessel attacked today, Sep 13 near Hengam Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
text:
"Footage of the Iranian vessel attacked today, Sep 13 near Hengam Island in the Strait of Hormuz."

"One killed, four injured in US attack on container ship off Iran’s Qeshm Island"

"Details of the US attack on a container ship in the waters off Qeshm County"

"🔺 On Sunday morning, a commercial container ship was attacked in the waters near Hengam Island and the Shib Deraz coast of Qeshm. A projectile from the American enemy struck the vessel, resulting in the martyrdom of one crew member and the injury of four others."

"🔺 The incident occurred at approximately 5 a.m. on Sunday, and the targeted vessel was a commercial container ship."

"According to information obtained by a Mehr reporter from official sources in the Hormozgan Governorate, the ship had 10 crew members at the time of the attack. Following the strike, Jamshid Rajabi was martyred, and four other crew members were injured."

"🔺 The incident took place in the maritime area near Hengam Island and the Shib Deraz coast of Qeshm. Further details regarding the nature of the attack, the condition of the vessel, and the status of the injured will be announced subsequently."
